title: Cyrus and the Extraction
author: Vesper Winterbourne
blurb: Mirabel Crane, a whistle-blower living under four names, hasn't slept through the night since the incident. Then every record of a flight vanishes while it's still in the air — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must get the truth past three governments and one assassin, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
